description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise in Richmond offering takeout and delivery pizza made with organic tomato sauce and 100% Canadian wheat dough. The menu emphasizes quality ingredients including meats raised without antibiotics and no artificial colours or flavours. As a takeout-only location, it is primarily suited to cyclists looking to order food for the road rather than dine in.

The website is a corporate homepage (panago.com), not a location-specific page, so no address, bike parking, washroom, or other location-specific amenity evidence is available. Plant-based and dairy-free menu options are explicitly listed on the homepage.
